name: WIKES
description: A large-scale benchmark for entity summarization in knowledge graphs that includes entities, their summaries, and connections. It features a dataset generator for testing summarization algorithms on different subgraphs without requiring human annotation.
reputation: A niche but useful research benchmark for knowledge-graph entity summarization, mainly cited in the KG summarization literature rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Combines graph algorithms and NLP models; scalable and cost-effective without human annotation.
